cover.title: Sample Programme – Cutover runbook
cover.subtitle: Source region (A) → Target region (B)
cover.abstract: Sequence, rationale, controls, decision points and rollback for the production cutover of the sample perimeter. Baseline: general cutover runbook and asset runbooks.

revisions: First draft: structure, principles, rollback plan; issued for review
approvals: Go/No-Go at the plan gate and at the decision points
Asset runbooks, business tests, production changes
conventions: **T** is the cutover day. T-n and T+n are counted in calendar days; the mapping to dates is in Annex A.
**[Proposed]** marks content proposed by this document that requires approval.
**[TBC]** marks a value to be confirmed; every TBC is listed in the open points.
**Roles, not names,** are used in this document; the named contact list is held separately.

blocks.text: This runbook defines how the production cutover of the sample perimeter is executed, verified and, if needed, rolled back.
**In scope:** the assets of the sample perimeter and the entry points that move with them.
**Out of scope:** functional acceptance, which remains with the application owners.

items: **Verified, not executed:** every step has an exit check with evidence.
**Rollback defined before execution:** decision points and the point of no return are known in advance.
Each decision point has a time limit [TBC].

blocks.text: R responsible · A accountable · S supports · C consulted · I informed.

rows: No write reaches the source during the copy

blocks.text: Intermediate start times depend on the durations measured at the rehearsal.
